name: app-icon
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a premium desktop APPLICATION ICON for the serious medieval political strategy game Game of Crowns. Square 1:1 canvas, 1024x1024 requested. The text reads EXACTLY "GoC": uppercase G, lowercase o, uppercase C. This exact mixed-case spelling is essential. Pronounced gee-oh-see.
Reference image is the APPROVED full game logo, for its refined tall Roman serif, pale antique bronze and understated tiny crown. Translate that brand faithfully into a strong compact GoC icon. Large elegant G and C with smaller lowercase o between, one baseline, perfectly readable at 32px. Fine sharp wedge serifs, refined architectural forms, balanced substantial stems, moderate stroke contrast. Muted pale aged champagne-bronze over near-black charcoal. Shallow engraved edges and slight metal grain only. No thick bevel or extruded type.
One TINY low broad three-point crown above centre, thin and restrained, no jewels; secondary to GoC. The monogram occupies central 68% of width. All design must fit within a centred 70%-diameter circle so a social avatar circle never crops it.
BACKGROUND: full-bleed solid opaque charcoal-black #151719 with barely visible worn stone texture. Square corners on canvas; let operating systems apply masks, do not draw rounded container. No outside margin or fake app mockup. No glossy highlights. Restrained premium historical drama mood, grave and adult. No scenery, no bright gold, no toy, birds, shields, jewels, ribbons, fire, glow, watermark, additional text or border. Only the GoC letters and tiny crown on the dark square.
